selected_evidence.requirement: node1 routes between lan-a and lan-b
selected_evidence.summary: Added opt1/opt2 interfaces on node1 (10.10.10.1, 10.10.20.1), configured node2/node3 with static IPs and cross routes, and confirmed ping connectivity across the two networks via node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Refuse TCP port 23 between lan-a and lan-b
selected_evidence.summary: Added block rules for tcp/23 between opt1 and opt2 in config.xml, reloaded pf, and confirmed a live TCP/23 connection attempt from node2 to node3 timed out (refused) while a general pass rule still allows other traffic.

selected_evidence.requirement: Record every refused attempt in a log on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Block rules configured with <log>1</log>; node1's /var/log/filter/filter_*.log shows block entries with the matching rule label for tcp/23 traffic 10.10.10.2->10.10.20.2 port 23.

selected_evidence.requirement: Show a log entry produced by an attempt made from node2
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 initiated a TCP/23 connect to node3 (10.10.20.2), which timed out; node1's filter log line with sequenceId 209-211 shows block,in,vtnet1,tcp,10.10.10.2,10.10.20.2,...,23 matching that exact attempt.

Captured baseline kern.boottime (16:24:13), issued a background reboot, observed SSH connection timeout confirming disconnection, polled until reachable again with kern.boottime changed to 16:29:05, then verified interfaces, firewall rules, and block+log behavior all recovered with a fresh logged refusal from node2.

Captured baseline boot_id (d6298ced...), triggered systemctl reboot, observed connection timeout, polled until reachable with new boot_id (086ac571...), and verified static IP/route/connectivity to node1 recovered.
